title: Trading Forge V4 execution graph — Phase 1 expanded

authority.status_join_condition: ADVISOR-STATE, newest report AR-612, and newest ruling R-573 are joined at campaign commit 0820f88f5dd451aee827112265b64ecc0219898f. Any later campaign commit, AR, ruling, or state rewrite invalidates node states until the graph is refreshed. Refreshing this epoch asserts FRESHNESS ONLY -- it does not re-verify that the node-state partition is still true, which remains a desk judgement.
authority.rule: The blueprint owns requirements. This graph owns execution ordering only after adoption.

objective.phase_1_exit: ≥1 tier-A spec compiles with ALL load-bearing conditions concretely bound AND the compile-fidelity forensics gate passes calibration.
objective.trading_ready_boundary: Phase 1 is compiler completion, not trading readiness. Trading readiness additionally requires the Phase-2 battery and Phase-3 paper/shadow evidence.

scheduler.ready_rule: A node is ready only when every incoming hard edge has a present, pinned artifact and every acceptance predicate on that artifact is true.
scheduler.edge_rule: Every hard edge names the exact output artifact consumed. An ordering claim without a consumed artifact is a fake edge and is removed.
scheduler.fan_in_rule: A fan-in reports expected and received predecessor IDs. Missing predecessors are RED, never omitted.
scheduler.compiler_environment_rule: A TypeScript mutation is valid only against a named and content-pinned compiler surface: TypeScript version, compiler options, standard libraries, ambient declarations, and fixture files.
scheduler.diagnostic_ownership_rule: Each mutation has one primary catcher. Syntax already owned by a specific catcher is excluded from generic catchers, and the fixture asserts that the primary catcher fired while competing catchers stayed silent.
scheduler.priority_rule: Prioritize ready nodes on the Phase-1 money path, then nodes that unlock the largest downstream fan-in; park off-path work when it competes for the same lane.

nodes.title: Close P0-vNext design contract
nodes.acceptance: AR-588 design records the ESM-only direction and CJS wrapper-this mutation; hands the exact design blob and manifest to the isolated executable prototype.

nodes.title: Execute isolated source/runtime admission prototype
nodes.acceptance: Prototype exists and executes all 52 registered records. Its 49-of-52 figure is provisional and cannot cross a hard edge because R-543 and the external AR-589 review found invalid coverage, non-exclusive ownership, module-identity, required-project membership, and print-only enforcement defects.

nodes.title: Correct and red-proof the executable admission prototype
outputs: effective-module tuple and same-source CJS-ESM differential
nodes.acceptance: The six populations are disjoint and sum to the frozen 52; surface-invalid rows are inadmissible, mutation-as-type-error rows name the type checker, and only surface-valid fixture-valid rows may credit 1b-S. Type-only identifiers stay silent while the same spelling in value position is exclusively FREE_REF, with POSITION_UNCLASSIFIED fail-closed. Fixture scaffolding preserves emitted behavior. The effective compiler-emitter-loader tuple is an input; one source is executed as CJS and ESM; exactly one callable project export is required; every terminal acceptance failure exits non-zero after evidence collection while the restored control exits zero.

nodes.title: Independent grade of corrected admission prototype
nodes.acceptance: The grader independently re-plants R-543 and external AR-589 defects, runs a novel complement-first hunt, and reports SOUND or honest null with exact coverage and limitations against the corrected prototype commit.

nodes.title: Close mutation validity and diagnostic ownership
nodes.acceptance: Consumes the corrected prototype and its independent grade, including honest misses and novel findings; closes only the design promises demonstrated by those artifacts, with unresolved coverage retained as explicit residuals.

nodes.title: Independent design grade
nodes.acceptance: SOUND or honest-null coverage receipt against the exact design blob; novel false-green hunt included.

nodes.title: Implement P0-vNext instrument
nodes.acceptance: Every pre-registered mutation bites through its named catcher; clean controls remain green; CI wiring exists.

nodes.title: Independent implementation grade
nodes.acceptance: Fresh re-plants plus novel attacks against the exact implementation commit; pipeline limitations named.

nodes.title: Freeze current additive baseline
nodes.acceptance: Delivered and independently re-censused over the exact 43-row by 7-axis frame. The freeze is complete over that frame and nothing else; its verifier closeout is durable evidence, not standing CI enforcement.

nodes.title: Freeze source-keyed truth membership
nodes.acceptance: Delivered and independently re-censused: 43 source-keyed rows crossed with seven axes produce 301 cells, with asserted, not-applicable, and unadjudicated states preserved and the frame limitation explicit.

nodes.title: Rule producer-proof and runtime-integration lane authority
nodes.acceptance: Producer SHA, executing runtime SHA, graph-to-spec handoff, transfer receipt, and forbidden direct-tree edits named.

nodes.title: Pin stranded-capability register before authorization
nodes.acceptance: Register is read and hashed before any new detector/binder/classifier authorization; no concurrent writer changes it under the reader.

nodes.title: Deterministic Gate-B producer proof
nodes.acceptance: Context is retained as typed metadata, executable market-session predicates survive, empty-spine stays fail-closed, provenance quote derives from exact source slice.

nodes.title: Port Gate B into authoritative runtime
nodes.acceptance: All actual consumers are enumerated; structured metadata is preferred; conflicts fail closed; TypeScript/Python parity and CI pass in the executing lineage.

nodes.title: Run source-keyed control/treatment sweep
nodes.acceptance: Every consumer input/output and control-flow transition is recorded; proxy-only improvements and denominator artifacts are excluded from efficacy.

nodes.title: Re-rank current Tier-A spearheads
nodes.acceptance: Ranking uses current output and exact current identities; historical C8 unlock claims are not inherited as current targets.

nodes.title: Targeted corpus-B respin
nodes.acceptance: Only the smallest named target set is re-extracted; transcript-audit passes per video; spec hashes are pinned.

nodes.title: Freeze current Surface-B membership and consumer profile
nodes.acceptance: Current N, exact spec hashes, load-bearing membership, authority citations, and consumer profile are frozen before any result is read.

nodes.title: Complete target SMC/load-bearing binding
outputs: fully bound target spec or attribution-complete refusal
nodes.acceptance: Every load-bearing condition is concrete or honestly refused; ordered concepts compile as state machines; no count-only completion claim.

nodes.title: Calibrate compile fidelity in authoritative runtime
nodes.acceptance: Calibration runs on the frozen current Surface-B population in the executing runtime lineage; P0 synthetic green is not cited as fidelity.

nodes.title: Phase-1 exit
nodes.acceptance: P0 instrument qualified AND at least one frozen current Tier-A spec fully bound AND compile-fidelity calibration passes.

nodes.title: Phase-2 battery / walk-forward / Monte Carlo
outputs: survivor packet or attribution-complete no-survivor verdict
nodes.acceptance: Null calibration predates the wave; every failure has four-bin attribution; at least one survivor passes pre-registered gates or the no-survivor cause routes work explicitly.

nodes.title: Phase-3 paper and shadow conveyor
nodes.acceptance: At least one survivor completes paper and shadow floor inside pre-registered parity bands; operator purchase briefing is on record.

nodes.title: Phase-3.5 first thirty funded days
nodes.acceptance: Thirty funded days, zero firm-rule breaches, guards observed or affirmatively exercised, payout path proven, no repeated unattributed stop-gate.

nodes.title: Phase-4 horizontal scale
nodes.acceptance: Phase-3.5 exit and cold-recovery drill receipt exist; scaling remains horizontal within firm limits.

nodes.title: C2 session-role resolver yield
nodes.acceptance: Measurement only; no binding/extraction change.

nodes.title: Semantic-role classifier shadow migration
nodes.acceptance: HOLDOUT-26 remains untuned; no classifier flag flip or DB write.

nodes.title: Stranded-capability register refresh
nodes.acceptance: Register identities and current stranded state reconcile; readers pin before writer moves it.
